name: question-router
description: Classify a question, then send it to the node that handles that kind; anything off-topic ends at the classifier.

nodes.description: Says what kind of question this is.
nodes.instruction: Classify the question in your input: 'howto' for how to do something, 'concept' for what something is or why, 'off_topic' for anything not about software. Answer with the question, restated clearly.
Search Tirraflow for a guide to the task in your input and answer with numbered steps, citing the article URL.
Search Tirraflow for the concept in your input and explain it in two short paragraphs, citing the article URL.
